title: Mountaineering and climbing: from first hill to pro
intro: Start with the basics, then pick a track. The walking track takes you to the Mountain Leader award. The climbing track goes from your first rope to instructing and coaching. Both end with kit, costs and safety.

items.summary: Your first steps in hill walking, coasteering and rock climbing. Then pick a track.
Two-day courses to become an independent hill and mountain walker.
Lowland Leader and Hill and Moorland Leader, your first group-leading awards.
40 quality mountain days and wild camps: the classic UK mountain award.
Multi-pitch and mountain instructing. Needs the Mountain Leader award plus serious climbing, so both tracks meet here.
Four courses, from your first rope to leading sport and trad.
Instructing climbing and bouldering sessions indoors.
Instructing on single-pitch crags and walls.
Foundation, Development and Performance Coach: helping climbers move better.
The Youth Climbing Series, trials and British Championships.
Prices, membership, the under-18s licensing law and safety basics. Both tracks end here.
